title: Bevy UI Asset Manifest Schema
description: OD-authored asset manifest that mirrors HTML/CSS image references into parser hints for 9-slice, atlas, state textures, and validation. Does NOT replace HTML/CSS layout information.

screenName.description: Logical screen name matching the wireframe/screen brief (e.g., 'main-menu', 'race-hud').

sourceHtml.description: Relative path to the index.html this manifest describes.

wireframeRef.description: Path to the UX wireframe screenshot or HTML used as structural blueprint.

assets.description: List of asset entries. Each entry maps one or more image files to a UI node.

id.description: Unique asset identifier within this manifest. Used for variant tracking and selective regeneration.

kind.description: Asset role category. Determines how the parser treats slicing, scaling, and state binding.

path.description: Relative path from project root to the primary image file. Must match a URL referenced in HTML/CSS.

nodeSelector.description: CSS selector identifying the HTML node this asset binds to. e.g., '#play_button', '.top-bar', '[data-action=start-race]'.

role.description: Visual role within the UI composition. Guides parser assembly priority.

states.description: Per-state texture overrides. Keys are interaction states; values are file paths.

slice9.description: 9-slice border configuration for panels, buttons, and resizable containers.

mode.description: How the center region fills when resized.

atlas.description: Sprite atlas metadata for animated or multi-frame icons.

scaleMode.description: How the image fills its container. 'nine-slice' requires slice9 config.

dimensions.description: Expected pixel dimensions at design resolution. Used for validation against browser preview.

adoptionStatus.description: Lifecycle stage of this asset. Only 'adopted' assets are included in final engine build.

sourceRef.description: Back-reference to upstream artifacts that produced or informed this asset.

artPrompt.description: MiniMax/ComfyUI prompt ID or description used to generate this asset.

svgSource.description: If kind is rasterized-svg, path to original .svg file.

comparisonPath.description: Path to comparison.html showing wireframe vs preview vs final.

validationCheckpoints.description: Expected bounds/layout checkpoints for browser-vs-engine visual parity validation.

deliveryNotes.description: Free-form notes from the UI Artist about asset coverage gaps, known issues, or producer feedback.
